sn52.9:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca sāriputto vesāliyaṃ viharanti ambapālivane.
sn52.9:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca:
sn52.9:2.1: “vippasannāni kho te āvuso anuruddha indriyāni, parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.
sn52.9:2.2: katamenāyasmā anuruddho vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharatī”ti.
sn52.9:2.3: catūsu khvāhaṃ āvuso satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmi.
sn52.9:2.5: idhāhaṃ āvuso, kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.9:2.8: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.9:2.9: imesu khvāhaṃ āvuso catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmi.
sn52.9:2.10: yo so āvuso bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimutto, so imesu catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto bahulaṃ viharatīti.
sn52.9:3.1: lābhā vata no āvuso, suladdhaṃ vata no āvuso,
sn52.9:3.2: ye mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhāva assumha āsabhiṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassāti.
